## JARVIS Research v1 - real products from CJ Dropshipping, sent to your Telegram
Runs every **Monday 10:00** (Toronto) and when you click Execute. Searches 3 product themes on CJ (no electronics, cosmetics, kids, food, medical), gets the supplier price and **real shipping quotes to Canada**, does the profit math (no AI), lets the free AI add one note per product, and sends you the top 5.
Credentials: **CJ API key** (Custom Auth) in *CJ get token*; **OmniRoute** in *AI notes*; **JARVIS Telegram** in *Send product photo*, *Send report* and *Send voice message*. The voice comes from the free Piper service on the server (no credential). Check each one after import: n8n may auto-pick the wrong credential.
All money figures are estimates. Nothing is ordered or published. At the end JARVIS sends a short spoken summary (voice message).
After the report it writes a summary to the data table **jarvis_memory** so the JARVIS screen and Telegram know what was sent.
